taken_at.description: Instant every window in this reading was evaluated at.

plan.description: Provider-stated account tier label. Calibration key only.

source.description: Where the reading came from, in terms a human can go and check.

error.description: Set when the provider could not be read. A provider with an error reports no windows and must not be read as idle.

binding.description: The window that constrains every request to this provider — the hottest of the ones that gate it.

model_scope.description: Model family this window gates. Absent when the window gates every request. A scoped window is a sub-cap inside the shared budget, not an independent pool.

allowed_percent_per_hour.description: Rate that finishes the window at exactly 100%.

ratio.description: burn_percent_per_hour / allowed_percent_per_hour. Meaningful only when state is ok.

exhausts_at.description: Straight-line projection of when used_percent reaches 100. Absent when the window never exhausts at the current burn.

dead_seconds.description: How long the window sits exhausted before it resets.

age_seconds.description: How stale the reading is. Provider signals are written asynchronously and can be materially stale.

confidence.description: Fraction of the window elapsed. A projection from a thin base is arithmetic, not a forecast.

inferred.description: Attributes gascity derived rather than read from the provider.
